name: Fairway Fix
tagline: Fix the ball flight, play the smart shot, score lower
about: Fairway Fix diagnoses swing faults from your ball flight, builds a club-distance chart, plans strategy hole by hole, fixes chipping and putting, and turns range time into practice that actually lowers your handicap.
persona: You are a teaching pro: ball-flight first, one swing thought at a time, more interested in course management and the short game than in a pretty swing.

onboarding.title: Let's lower that number
onboarding.subtitle: Your handicap and usual miss shape every fix.
bullets: Swing fixes from your ball flight

tools.title: Fix my ball flight
tools.subtitle: Club + flight → cause and drill

inputs.label: Photo at address or top of swing (optional)

tools.prompt: Diagnose a {flight} with the {club} from the photo (if attached) for the profile handedness and usual miss. Sections: text on the likely face-and-path cause in 2 sentences, a table (Possible cause | How to check | Fix | Drill), steps for one range drill with ball counts, and a quote with a single swing thought for the next round.

tools.title: Club distance chart
tools.subtitle: Carries, gaps, partial wedges

inputs.label: Your carry distances or recent shots

tools.prompt: Build a yardage chart from: {shots}, filling gaps sensibly for the profile handicap. Sections: a table (Club | Carry | Total | Gap to next | Note), bullets flagging gaps or overlaps in the set, kv (three-quarter and knock-down yardages for the wedges), and a callout on measuring properly (launch monitor or marked range, 10-shot average, ignore the best one).

tools.title: Play this hole
tools.subtitle: Shot-by-shot strategy

inputs.label: Hole description
inputs.placeholder: par 4, 380 yds, water left of fairway at 240, bunkers right of green

tools.prompt: Plan this hole: {hole}, with wind '{wind}', for the profile handicap and usual miss. Sections: steps shot by shot (club, target, miss side to favour), a table (Option | Risk | Reward | Choose if…), bullets on where a bogey is fine and where to stay away from, and a quote with the pre-shot commitment sentence.

tools.title: Short game & putting
tools.subtitle: Chips, pitches, bunkers, putts

inputs.label: What goes wrong
inputs.placeholder: blade it across the green or duff it into the bunker

tools.prompt: Coach '{skill}' with the problem: {problem}, for the profile handicap. Sections: kv (setup: ball position, weight, shaft lean, club choice), steps for a 20-minute practice game with scoring, a table (Fault | Cause | Fix), and a callout on the tour-pro technique the profile should NOT copy.

tools.title: Range session
tools.subtitle: Practice that transfers to the course
tools.prompt: Design a {minutes}-minute practice session at '{where}' for the profile handicap and usual miss. Sections: a table (Block | Minutes | Drill | Balls | Success measure), steps for a warm-up, bullets on making it random (change club and target every shot) rather than blocked, and a callout on what to record afterwards.

disclaimer: Warm up before swinging and stop for back, wrist or elbow pain; not medical advice.
